title: Brussels: Rioters clash with police at anti-austerity rally
summary: Violent rioters, many of whom were masked, confronted police at the edge of an anti-austerity march in Brussels. Police responded with water cannons and tear gas.

title: EU's Covid recovery fund was 'absolutely a success': European Court of Auditors' Pierre Moscovici
summary: 2020 was an annus horribilis. Covid stalked the land. Lockdowns, curfews and social distancing were the order of the day. But there was a silver lining: European countries showed themselves to be capable of great solidarity, jointly procuring vaccines and then agreeing on a mammoth post-Covid recovery fund, the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF). That fund has disbursed €450 billion in grants and loans to EU member states since 2021. As the RRF enters its crucial final phase, we take stock of the situation with Pierre Moscovici, the French member of the European Court of Auditors (ECA).

title: 2026 Nobel Peace Prize: Who is Navanethem “Navi” Pillay?

title: 2027 spring-summer ready-to-wear collections: Audacity, movement and sensuality

title: Israel a rare dissenting voice as praise pours in for Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay

In the latest rankings, France's results were the worst it has ever had, and Germany's school pupils got their worst PISA report card too.
